diagnostics.title: MCP 2024-11-05 event stream opened on the ungoverned chain (sessions unisolated)
diagnostics.summary: A caller opened an MCP 2024-11-05 event stream while the deployment runs the ungoverned chain. Every caller there is one owner, so a session id (which this revision carries in a URL) isolates nothing between callers: any caller that learns it can post into the session. Raised once per plane instance, on the first such stream.
diagnostics.action: Govern the deployment (configure an auth chain) so each MCP session is bound to the key that opened it, or accept that callers of this deployment are not isolated from one another.
